mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_stat ( stat_date, total_users, new_users, active_users, total_docs, new_docs, total_kbs, new_kbs, total_comments ) VALUES ( #{statDate}, #{totalUsers}, #{newUsers}, #{activeUsers}, #{totalNotes}, #{newNotes}, #{totalKbs}, #{newKbs}, #{totalComments} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_users = VALUES(total_users), new_users = VALUES(new_users), active_users = VALUES(active_users), total_docs = VALUES(total_docs), new_docs = VALUES(new_docs), total_kbs = VALUES(total_kbs), new_kbs = VALUES(new_kbs), total_comments = VALUES(total_comments)
